For a beginner, start with reliable, multi-use essentials: navigation (map/compass or GPS; sometimes a service-free PLB), headlamp/lantern with spare batteries, first-aid kit for minor injuries/blisters, shelter (plus space blanket/bivvy for backcountry), water container and purification/filtration, fire starters, knife/multi-tool, comfortable activity-suitable backpack, sturdy terrain-appropriate footwear, and weather-appropriate waterproof/insulating layers. Add dry bags/stuff sacks, packing cubes, whistle, map case, phone protection, sunscreen, lip balm, spare batteries, and a water bottle/hydration system as needed. Prioritize pack, water, navigation, light, first aid, shelter, and emergency communication; add extras according to trip and conditions.
